note: Cambria is drawn with Caladea; LibreOffice spaces Caladea lines by its typo metrics (1.15 em), Layout by the Windows metrics Word uses (1.30 em). Calibri, Arial, Times and Courier lines match.

Glyphs, line breaks and positions match LibreOffice (Chuvadi.Pdf 3.26 shaping; pixel score under 10%). Text differs only because Chuvadi.Pdf extracts LibreOffice's Tamil text wrongly (vowel signs repeated or moved); poppler extracts the same reference exactly as Layout writes it. Reported to the Pdf chat.
As d03. Spaces between Tamil words now take the Tamil font and size (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word: line 2 ends with காலை.
Space between paragraphs is the larger of space after and space before (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word.
A paragraph holding only a page break keeps its mark on the old page (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word.
Rows make room for their horizontal borders (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word.

After a nested table the cell holds its required empty paragraph; Layout gives it a line, as Word shows it, LibreOffice hides it, so the next outer row starts one line lower in Layout. To confirm in Word.
Newspaper columns (w:cols) are not laid out yet: Layout flows the section in one column.

Layout makes a line holding an inline picture as tall as the picture plus the font descent (the picture sits on the baseline, as in Word); LibreOffice uses the picture height alone. About 3 pt per picture. To confirm in Word.
Each tab draws the leader of its own stop (fixed in Layout by this corpus).
LibreOffice does not draw the dot leader of a positional tab; Layout does, as Word does.
One line breaks one word later in Layout than in LibreOffice (a word that fits within about 1 pt of the right margin). To confirm in Word.
Lines pass within tolerance, but the pixel score is high: Layout sizes the last line by the 11 pt paragraph mark as well, as Word does; LibreOffice uses the 8 pt text alone. To confirm in Word.

Footnotes match LibreOffice on page 1 (positions within 0.6 pt, two-inch separator). Endnotes differ: LibreOffice puts them on a page of their own with its endnote page style; Layout, like Word, continues them after the text. To confirm in Word.

LibreOffice exports the markup (deleted text shown); Layout lays out the final view (changes accepted, comment balloons not drawn), as the Docs integration guide says. To confirm what Word prints by default (Print Markup).
Complex fields (REF, PAGEREF, SEQ) show their cached results; bookmark and field markers take no room.

Fill, outline, insets and text match. LibreOffice places the right-aligned box 8.45 pt further left (it keeps the 9 pt wrap distance inside the margin); Layout aligns the box edge to the margin, so lines beside it hold about one word more. To confirm in Word.

The floating table is placed 200 pt from the margin in the text flow; Layout does not yet wrap text beside floating tables or apply their vertical position (a warning says so). LibreOffice wraps the text beside it.
w:sym characters drawn in their font.
DejaVu Serif comes only from the document (LibreOffice and Layout both use the embedded font; it is in neither font set).
